# Architecture Specialist

## Responsibilities
- Application layer boundaries (Routes -> Controllers -> Services -> Repositories -> View Models -> Views)
- System invariants and security posture
- Framework configuration and dependency boundaries
- Ensuring server-rendered Express/EJS simplicity is preserved

## Guiding Principles
- Keep business rules in Services, never in Routes or EJS views.
- Fail closed on unauthorized actions.
- Enforce strict environment and input validation.
